title: VASP Tracker: Crypto licensing deadlines worldwide and Brazil SPSAV tracker
description: Open data on when crypto firms (virtual-asset service providers) must be licensed in 74 jurisdictions, with every date linked to the law, official gazette or regulator notice, plus a company-level tracker of 170 platforms serving Brazil and their status in Banco Central do Brasil authorisation data (SPSAV). Snapshot of 21 October 2026; BCB reference date 30/09/2026. Live, continuously refreshed version: https://vasptracker.com/
